operating_notes.text: Q4FY26 gross advances stood at ₹1.54 lakh Cr and deposits at ₹1.66 lakh Cr.
CASA ratio stood above 29% in Q1FY27
Retail to total deposits ratio (CASA + RTD) stood at 74% in Q1FY27
Secured advances constituted nearly 57% of total loan book in Q1FY27
Q1FY27 secured advances mix rose to 56.8%, up 473 bps YoY.
Q1FY27 EEB stress pool fell 31% YoY to ₹39.8 bn, with PCR on the stress pool at 75.4%.
Q1FY27 credit cost was 1.8%, down 167 bps YoY.
SBI Mutual Fund held 11,48,94,258 shares, or 7.1314% of Bandhan Bank's paid-up capital, as at 22-Jul-2026, up from 5.5177%.
Q1FY27 gross advances ₹1.56 lakh Cr, up 16% YoY; deposits ₹1.65 lakh Cr.
Q1FY27 slippages ₹1,079 Cr, of which EEB ₹604 Cr.
Q1FY27 credit cost 1.8%, EEB credit cost 3.3%; PCR 86% including technical write-offs.
Interim Chief of Internal Vigilance Prakash E resigned; last working day November 07, 2026, successor yet to be named.

Promoter Bandhan Financial Holdings held 37.53% but could exercise voting rights on only 26% (41,88,89,010 of 60,46,71,711 shares) under Section 12(2) of the Banking Regulation Act; 18,57,82,701 votes were treated as invalid.
Nitin Arora, currently Axis Bank's Chief of Internal Vigilance since October 2023, joins Bandhan Bank as CIV from September 22, 2026; interim CIV Prakash E ceases on that date.
Sandip Kumar Bubna's interim CAE/HIA term extended four months to February 26, 2027 or until a permanent CAE joins; he joined the bank in August 2025 to head Information Systems Audit.
September 30, 2026: CASA ratio 27.97% (June 2026: 26.71%); bulk deposits 40.35% of total term deposits (June 2026: 37.31%).
September 30, 2026: pan-bank collection efficiency excluding NPAs 98.9%, EEB 98.6%, non-EEB 99.2%.
September 30, 2026: LCR approximately 137.88%; retail deposits 70.93% of total deposits.

timeline.summary: Bandhan Bank Limited’s **Indranil Banerjee** announced a Q4FY26/FY26 earnings call for **April 28, 2026, at 17:00 IST** via ChorusCall.
Bandhan Bank received RBI approval for the appointment of Mr. Debasish Panda as Part-Time Chairman for three years.
Bandhan Bank disclosed an RBI penalty of ₹41.80 lakh imposed for contraventions under the Banking Regulation Act and KYC directions.
Q4FY26 results (standalone): interest earned ₹5,428.43 Cr (-0.1% YoY), net profit ₹534.14 Cr (+68.0% YoY).
Bandhan Bank’s Board recommended a ₹1.5 dividend per equity share (15% of ₹10 face value) for FY2026, pending shareholder approval at the AGM.
Bandhan Bank reported Q4FY26 net profit of ₹534 Cr (+68% YoY) and recommended a dividend of ₹1.50 per share.
Bandhan Bank Limited’s **Indranil Banerjee** announced an **Analysts/Institutional Investors Meet** on **May 29, 2026**, in **Mumbai** and **online** via 360 ONE Capital and TRINITY INDIA 2026.
Bandhan Financial Holdings Ltd. confirms no encumbrance on Bandhan Bank’s equity shares since inception, including FY2026, under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4).
Shareholders of Bandhan Bank Limited approved Mr. Debashish Mukherjee’s appointment as Special Independent Director via remote e-voting on June 05, 2026, with 99.35% support.
Bandhan Bank Limited hosted an earnings call on July 21, 2026, at 17:30 IST to discuss Q1FY27 performance for analysts and investors.
Bandhan Bank reported Q1FY27 PAT of ₹502 Cr, up 35% YoY, driven by 5.9% YoY NII growth and 40% YoY drop in provisions.
Bandhan Bank reported Q1FY27 PAT of ₹502 Cr, up 35% YoY, as provisions fell 40% YoY, though pre-provision operating profit dropped 18.6% YoY.
Bandhan Bank fixed August 17, 2026 as record date for dividend and August 24, 2026 for its 12th AGM.
SBI Mutual Fund raised its stake in Bandhan Bank to 7.1314% after net buying 2,59,97,814 shares (1.6137% of capital) on 22-Jul-2026.
Bandhan Bank reported Q1FY27 PAT of ₹502 Cr, up 35% YoY, but management extended the 1.6-1.8% ROA aspiration beyond Q4FY27 due to rising funding and tech costs.
Bandhan Bank's interim Chief of Internal Vigilance Prakash E resigned on August 10, 2026 for personal reasons, with his last working day on November 07, 2026; a successor is being appointed.

Bandhan Bank's 12th AGM on 24-Aug-2026 passed all 7 resolutions; including FY26 accounts; dividend; Debasish Panda as Independent Director and Non-Executive Chairman; and higher statutory auditor remuneration

Bandhan Bank's board recommended re-appointing Rajinder Kumar Babbar as Executive Director & CBO for three years from March 08, 2027 (subject to RBI and shareholder approval), extended Amitava Goswami as CCO and Sandip Bubna as interim CAE, and named Nitin Arora as Chief of Internal Vigilance from September 22, 2026.
ICRA reaffirmed AA- (Stable) rating on ₹75 Cr NCDs and A1+ on ₹3,000 Cr CDs of Bandhan Bank on September 25, 2026.
On September 28, 2026, Crisil Ratings reaffirmed AA-/Stable on ₹230 Cr NCDs and A1+ on ₹6,000 Cr CDs, and withdrew ₹1,065 Cr NCDs post repayment.
Bandhan Bank's provisional September 30, 2026 update showed loans & advances at ₹1,40,041 Cr (down 13.1% YoY), total deposits at ₹1,58,075 Cr (down 9.2% YoY), CASA ratio at 27.97% and LCR at 137.88%.
Bandhan Bank received an exchange clarification request regarding media reports of Abu Dhabi's IHC exploring a promoter stake acquisition.
On October 13, 2026, Bandhan Bank clarified to stock exchanges that it was unaware of any negotiations regarding promoter stake acquisition by Abu Dhabi's IHC.
Bandhan Bank will host an earnings call with analysts and investors on Wednesday, October 28, 2026.
